name: Restricted SSH agent
description: Containers get the SSH keys in ~/.ssh/restricted and nothing else. The host side does the protecting; this Feature is the alarm, failing loudly when a container is handed any other agent, and the fallback mount for containers VS Code does not attach to.

installOpenSSHClient.description: Install the OpenSSH client when the image has none.

identities.description: ssh aliases for the restricted keys, comma separated, one "alias [user@]host key-type key-blob" each, e.g. "work git@github.com ssh-ed25519 AAAAC3...". Each becomes a Host block whose IdentityFile is that public key, signed by the agent; the private key never enters the container. Clone with alias:owner/repo.
